key_insight: Hilbert–Schmidt asymmetry can guide variational quantum optimization toward a target symmetry sector without requiring a symmetry-preserving preparation circuit.
engineering_relevance: Symmetry-based guidance offers a way to improve variational eigensolver accuracy and reliability while retaining flexible circuit designs.
method: Quantify deviation from a specified symmetry using quantum-accessible Hilbert–Schmidt asymmetry.
Use the asymmetry objective to guide optimization toward the target sector alongside energy minimization.
Test singlet ground-state preparation under collective SU(2) symmetry.
evidence_signal: Proof-of-principle tests on a five-qubit nuclear two-cluster Hamiltonian and collective spin models with up to 12 particles increased singlet probability and improved energy accuracy and ground-state fidelity compared with direct energy minimization.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish hardware-noise robustness or the measurement overhead of asymmetry-guided optimization.
paper_title: Symmetry-guided algorithms for variational quantum optimization
